entries.notes: Long multi-hop retrieval: coordinator splits query facets across workers; keep a verifier critic so retrieved evidence is checked before synthesis.
Short quantitative retrieval: one retrieval worker plus one verification worker under a coordinator is usually enough; larger topologies add cost without lift.
Multi-domain tool tasks: expand the branch owning the most tool domains into a subgroup so tool selection is split per domain.
Short tasks without tools rarely benefit from coordination; start single-agent and rely on the repair path if the answer collapses.
